surfaces.projection: simple cylindrical; north at top; Charon zero longitude at centre, Pluto encounter hemisphere at centre; no authoritative runtime spin phase implied
surfaces.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Southwest Research Institute
surfaces.licence: JPL Image Use Policy; image-specific credit retained; no endorsement
surfaces.maskPolicy: black/near-black no-data threshold <=2 in decoded source luminance; conservative visual coverage indicator, not a calibrated scientific confidence map
surfaces.note: Observed far hemisphere is genuinely low resolution. Pluto's 2400-wide source is resampled upward for a uniform 4k pipeline; no added observed detail. Black unmapped southern area is not a dark geological feature; no photographic color or relief reconstructed.
